claim: Prospective exact replication of the frozen scaling-paradox v1 fixed-rank core using three independently derived training seeds.
budget_scope: Dedicated maximum planning envelope for the 18-cell replication core; not a statement of live account balance.

core.description: Prospective exact replication of the v1 true-versus-shuffled fixed-rank core.

data_exposure.description: Prospective replication of the v1 nested-data diversity versus update-exposure decomposition.

adapter_rescue.description: Prospective replication of rank-128 rescue after the frozen combined-core gate passes.

preregistered_endpoints.primary_optimization: held-out per-residue DPO margin change from the matched reference policy
preregistered_endpoints.primary_biological: held-out full structural-gate yield on the frozen v1 prompt and sample-seed panel
preregistered_endpoints.analysis_unit: independent training seed, with prompts and candidates nested beneath seed and model
preregistered_endpoints.cohort_policy: Report the original and replication cohorts separately before the prespecified six-seed combined analysis.

stage_gate: The replication core begins only after all 18 original v1 core cells are terminal-valid. Replicated data exposure begins after both cores. Replicated adapter rescue begins only after the frozen combined six-seed gate passes.
